claims.claim_text: Democrats pledge to continue partnering with local communities on sustainable development such as passenger rail, bicycle and pedestrian paths, and other projects supporting livable cities.

Mayor Kevin Johnson predicts that investment in infrastructure, education, workforce training and public safety will support job creation, foster innovation and provide companies with a globally competitive workforce.
Mayor Kevin Johnson states that U.S. metropolitan areas, comprising cities and suburbs working together, are home to 86 percent of U.S. jobs.
Mayor Kevin Johnson reports that U.S. mayors call for renewed investment in metropolitan economies in the economic conditions described by the 2012 Democratic platform.
Mayor Kevin Johnson credits President Obama and the Democratic Party with over $100 billion in infrastructure investment as part of the Recovery Act.
Mayor Kevin Johnson credits earlier generations with building the United States through investment in the future and calls for similar future-oriented investment.
